character: Itachi Uchiha of the Akatsuki from Naruto Shippuden: slim young man, long black hair tied in a low ponytail with long bangs framing his face, red Mangekyo Sharingan eyes, tear-trough lines under his eyes, calm cold expression, Konoha forehead protector with a scratch through the symbol, long black high-collared Akatsuki cloak with red clouds and red lining, a ring on his finger, dark purple nail polish, dark sandals
short: Itachi Uchiha: long black ponytail, red Mangekyo Sharingan, scratched Konoha headband, high-collared black Akatsuki cloak with red clouds

variants.note: 5★/6★ forms: same outfit, but their jutsu is Clone Jutsu: Super Explosion (8 hits)

_ultimate_old._note: itachi_2199/2200 mirror itachi_2096 in data/characters.json (Totsuka Blade, 10 hits)

_fx_refs_note: fx_refs[0] = crop of the user's Naruto Blazing reference video (6* Itachi V3, full red Susano'o with Totsuka Blade and Yata Mirror), used only as a style/colour reference for generation
fx_style: Anime film still, painted cel-shaded, matching the Naruto Shippuden anime and Naruto Blazing style: clean lines, soft painted shading, smooth clean high-resolution rendering that fits hand-painted anime characters and backgrounds. NOT pixel art, NOT low-res game VFX, no glitter or particle noise. Colours: Itachi's Susano'o is translucent RED-ORANGE chakra with a soft cloudy texture, thin light-orange line-art swirls and flickering flame-shaped edges; fire and the Totsuka Blade are bright yellow-orange flame; light bursts are golden white; rocks and dust are natural browns. NO purple, NO blue, NO green.
